mcqs.question: In the context of the Association for Democratic Reforms (ADR) report on political donations above ₹20,000 during 2024–25, which pairing is correct?
options: Representation of the People Act, 1951 — disclosure above ₹20,000; ADR established in 1999
Electoral Trust Scheme, 2013 — disclosure above ₹20,000; ADR established in 1999
Social Security Code, 2020 — disclosure above ₹20,000; ADR established in 1999
Essential Commodities Act, 1955 — disclosure above ₹20,000; ADR established in 1999
mcqs.explanation: The Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides for disclosure of political donations above ₹20,000, and ADR was established in 1999. The Electoral Trust Scheme, 2013 is associated with electoral trusts, not the statutory disclosure requirement tested here.
